name: e06_scd2_en_hechos
sql: select d.customer_id, d.city, d.valid_from, d.valid_to, count(f.sale_sk) as ventas, min(dd.date) as primera_venta, max(dd.date) as ultima_venta from marts.fct_sales f join marts.dim_customer d on d.customer_sk = f.customer_sk join marts.dim_date dd on dd.date_sk = f.date_sk where d.customer_id = 1 group by 1,2,3,4 order by 3
